placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
Ashton Court is well suited to a picnic that becomes the centre of your day. Its open grassland and woodland routes let families combine time sitting together with space to explore.

Our family idea: choose your picnic spot before starting a short walk so children know where lunch will be. Pack a bag for every scrap of rubbish and leave wildlife to find its own food.

placepracticalinfo.heading: Practical information
placepracticalinfo.bestFor: Families who want a spacious picnic setting and optional walking.
placepracticalinfo.facilities: Estate cafes, toilets and paths; choose a spot near the facilities you need.
placepracticalinfo.parking: Use estate parking and check the current tariff and gate times.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: Some parts of the estate are hilly. Keep away from deer enclosures and follow notices about wildlife, events and permitted activities.
